name: Shem
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: “And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.” So Lamech begat Noah.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Shem, Ham, and Japheth went forth out of the ark and the whole earth was overspread from them. Ham dwelt in what is called Africa; Shem in the land mass toward Arabia; Japheth went into Europe.

note.label: Genesis 9: The Laws Before Moses and the Covenant of the Bow

points: Ham saw the nakedness of his father and did not cover him; Shem and Japheth went backward and covered their father without looking. The commandments concerning nakedness were being applied; Leviticus 18 opens those laws.

note.label: Genesis 9: The Laws Before Moses and the Covenant of the Bow

points: Blessed be the Lord God of Shem: it was revealed that the Messiah and the righteous seed would come through Shem.

note.label: Genesis 9: The Laws Before Moses and the Covenant of the Bow

points: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: so the generations of the sons of Noah.

note.label: All Nations Return To Their Land & Jerusalem Exalted

points: “The generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth”: yes, the sons of these generations become nations. They gave birth to multiples of nations. Shem gave birth to the Assyrians, Syrians, Elamites, Moabites, Ammonites and Israelites. Japheth gave birth to the Javanites: Germany, Greece, Rome, the Etruscans, the Minoans. Ham is explanatory: Hamites, Ethiopians, Egyptians, Canaanites, Libyans, Somalians.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: Shem is the father of all the children of Eber, and Eber is where the name Hebrew comes from.

note.label: Genesis 10: Shem, Ham, Japheth, and Nimrod

points: “Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber”: write this down, Eber is where the word Hebrew comes from. Heber means from the past, so when it says Hebrew it means the language from the past.

The word Shem means name. When you hear Amalek say Hashem will bless you, they’re saying the name, meaning the name of God will bless you. Rather than say Yahawah or Yahweh, they call God’s name Hashem.

Notice who the father is: Shem, the father of all the children of Eber. So what we’re reading are all the Hebrew nations. The white man says the only Hebrew is those in Israel; that’s a lie. This is why they don’t want us on mainstream TV: we will use the Bible and put holes in all their false doctrines. When they say you’re anti-Semitic: we are Shemitic, we come from Shem. Just like Elam, the East Indians, come from Shem. The Arabs come from Abraham; they are Shemitic. That’s what they say: don’t let them Israelites on, put the damn Christians on, put T.D. Jakes, Creflo; they go with our program, but not them dirty black ungodly Israelites.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

points: “The children of Shem; Elam”: Elam are your modern-day East Indians, and the people in Iran. “And Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.”

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

points: Watch the lifespans in the generations of Shem: five hundred years, then four hundred, then two hundred, then down past one hundred and nineteen with Nahor. The word of Genesis 6:3 is taking hold on man's days.

note.label: Genesis 11: Babel and the Separation of the Nations

points: “These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood.” From here the line of Shem is followed, generation by generation, down to Terah.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: so from Methuselah and Lamech came Noah. From Noah came who? Shem, Ham and Japheth. So those were the sons of Noah.
The line from the first man is set down in order: Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jered, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah, and the three sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Shem are named: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram, and the sons that came after them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The chosen line is set down plainly: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, who is Abraham.
